usage.callShape: POST https://x402-live-portrait.vercel.app/api/generate-x402 with JSON body {source_image_url, driving_video_url} (both HTTPS URLs, required); optional string flags flag_relative/flag_do_crop/flag_pasteback ("true"|"false")
quirks: Synchronous despite being video gen: the paid POST blocks until the result is ready and returns the final videoUrl directly in the body — no job id, no polling.
Both source_image_url and driving_video_url are REQUIRED and must be publicly reachable HTTPS URLs (the service fetches them server-side).
The optional flag_* params are STRINGS "true"/"false", not booleans.
Output is hosted on Vercel blob storage (public.blob.vercel-storage.com); download/re-host promptly if you need persistence.
usage.guide: POST a JSON body with source_image_url (a portrait image) and driving_video_url (the motion to transfer), both as public HTTPS URLs, to https://x402-live-portrait.vercel.app/api/generate-x402. Pay the $0.05 x402 charge on Base. The call is synchronous — when it returns 200 the body already contains the finished result. Read body.videoUrl for the animated mp4 and body.thumbnailUrl for the preview image; both are directly downloadable.
